mapper.select: /* SelectMngMapper.selectSelectionOdList : 선별마감시 그리드에 체크되어있는 데이터 제외한 목록선별 임시저장 리스트 조회 */ SELECT sel.CD_TYPE ,sel.INSPECTION_YN ,sel.CD_USE_TYPE ,sel.ECM_TYPE ,sel.ALLOWED_ITEM_CODE ,sel.ITEM_NAME AS SELECTION_ITEM_NAME ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,ISNULL(od.AMOUNT_USD, 0) AS AMOUNT_USD ,ISNULL(od.ORIG_COUNTRY, '') AS ORIG_COUNTRY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_SELECTION sel INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.OD_JOB_NO = sel.HOUSE_OD_JOB_NO WHERE sel.OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo}

/* SelectMngMapper.selectTempSelectionItemList : 품목검토 임시저장 리스트 조회 */ SELECT item.OD_JOB_NO AS MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,item.SEQ_NO_ID ,item.ITEM_NAME ,item.ALLOWED_ITEM_CODE AS HS_CODE ,item.CD_TYPE_YT_YN AS CD_YTYPE_YN ,item.CD_TYPE_BT_YN AS CD_BTYPE_YN ,item.INSPECTION_YN ,item.REVIEW_YN ,hbl.HOUSE_OD_JOB_NO AS OD_JOB_NO ,od.AMOUNT_USD ,od.CD_TYPE ,ISNULL(od.ORIG_COUNTRY, '') AS ORIG_COUNTRY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_SELECTION_ITEM item INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_SELECTION_ITEM_HBL hbl ON hbl.OD_JOB_NO = item.OD_JOB_NO AND hbl.SEQ_NO_ID = item.SEQ_NO_ID INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.OD_JOB_NO = hbl.HOUSE_OD_JOB_NO WHERE item.OD_JOB_NO = #{srchMasterOdJobNo} ORDER BY item.SEQ_NO_ID

/* SelectMngMapper.selectChkHsCodeList : 선별 리스트 조회(HsCode 업데이트할 내용) */ SELECT ETC2 AS KEYWORD ,ETC3 AS OPERATOR ,ETC6 AS HS_CODE ,ETC7 AS DOCUMENT_YN FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND ETC1 = 'HS'

/* SelectMngMapper.selectGoodsSelectionList : GOODS_SELECTION_INFO 조회 */
SELECT goods.ITEM_NAME ,goods.HS_CODE ,CASE goods.CD_YTYPE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CD_YTYPE_YN ,CASE goods.CD_BTYPE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CD_BTYPE_YN ,goods.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,goods.UPDATE_DATE_TIME
,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND USER_ID = goods.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND USER_ID = goods.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME
FROM TB_ECM_GOODS_SELECTION_INFO goods WHERE 1 = 1
AND goods.ITEM_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', dbo.GetRegExReplace(#{srchItemName}, '[^a-z0-9]', ''), '%')
AND goods.ITEM_NAME = dbo.GetRegExReplace(#{srchItemName}, '[^a-z0-9]', '')
AND goods.${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND goods.${srchDateGbn} <= DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat}))

/* SelectMngMapper.selectSelfSelection : 통관목록 자체선별(기초) 조회 */ SELECT selection.CODE AS JOB_NO ,selection.ETC1 AS SELECTION_TARGET ,selection.ETC2 AS KEYWORD ,selection.ETC3 AS OPERATOR ,selection.ETC4 AS DATA_FIELD ,selection.ETC5 AS REMARKS ,selection.ETC6 AS UPDATE_HS_CODE ,selection.ETC7 AS DOCUMENT_YN ,selection.USE_YN ,selection.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,selection.UPDATE_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = selection.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = selection.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = selection.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = selection.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL selection WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND CODE = #{jobNo}

/* SelectMngMapper.selectInspectionList : 검사선별관리 리스트 조회 */
SELECT MAX(od.OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(od.VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,MAX(od.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO ,MAX(od.PIECES) AS PIECES ,MAX(od.PIECES_REAL) AS PIECES_REAL ,MAX(od.GWT) AS GWT ,MAX(od.AMOUNT_CUR) AS AMOUNT_CUR ,MAX(od.ORIG_COUNTRY) AS ORIG_COUNTRY_CODE ,MAX(od.COMMODITY_ITEM) AS COMMODITY_ITEM ,MAX(od.BOUND) AS BOUND ,CONCAT(MAX(od.ECM_TYPE), (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = MAX(od.ENT_CODE) AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE' AND CODE = MAX(od.ECM_TYPE))) AS ECM_TYPE ,SUBSTRING(CONCAT('' , CASE WHEN MAX(opt1.CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN ', 국가' END , CASE WHEN MAX(opt2.CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN ', 우범' END , CASE WHEN MAX(opt3.CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN ', ASO' END , CASE WHEN MAX(opt4.CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN ', 송하인 상호' END , CASE WHEN MAX(opt5.CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN ', 송하인 주소' END , CASE WHEN MAX(opt6.CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN ', 송하인 전화번호' END , CASE WHEN MAX(opt7.CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN ', 수하인 상호' END , CASE WHEN MAX(opt8.CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN ', 수하인 주소' END , CASE WHEN MAX(opt9.CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN ', 수하인 전화번호' END , CASE WHEN MAX(od.PIECES) > 1 THEN ', 수량' END , CASE WHEN MAX(od.ECM_TYPE) = 'D' THEN ', 개인' END ), 3, 100) AS CHECK_INFO FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL opt1 ON opt1.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND opt1.GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND opt1.ETC1 = '3Y' AND opt1.ETC4 = 'DestCountry' AND opt1.ETC2 = od.DEST_COUNTRY AND opt1.ETC7 = od.DOCUMENT_YN
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL opt2 ON opt2.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND opt2.GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND opt2.ETC1 = '3Y' AND opt2.ETC4 = 'CommodityItem' AND opt2.ETC7 = od.DOCUMENT_YN AND od.COMMODITY_ITEM LIKE CONCAT('%', opt2.ETC2, '%')
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL opt3 ON opt3.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND opt3.GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND opt3.ETC1 = '3Y' AND opt3.ETC4 = 'ShipperBusinessId' AND opt3.ETC2 = dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.SHIPPER_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AND opt3.ETC7 = od.DOCUMENT_YN
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL opt4 ON opt4.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND opt4.GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND opt4.ETC1 = '3Y' AND opt4.ETC4 = 'ShipperName' AND opt4.ETC2 = od.SHIPPER_NAME AND opt4.ETC7 = od.DOCUMENT_YN
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL opt5 ON opt5.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND opt5.GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND opt5.ETC1 = '3Y' AND opt5.ETC4 = 'ShipperAddress' AND opt5.ETC2 = CONCAT(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS, od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A, od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B, od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C, od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D) AND opt5.ETC7 = od.DOCUMENT_YN
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL opt6 ON opt6.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND opt6.GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND opt6.ETC1 = '3Y' AND opt6.ETC4 = 'ShipperTel' AND opt6.ETC2 = od.SHIPPER_TEL AND opt6.ETC7 = od.DOCUMENT_YN
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL opt7 ON opt7.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND opt7.GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND opt7.ETC1 = '3Y' AND opt7.ETC4 = 'ConsigneeName' AND opt7.ETC2 = od.CONSIGNEE_NAME AND opt7.ETC7 = od.DOCUMENT_YN
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL opt8 ON opt8.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND opt8.GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND opt8.ETC1 = '3Y' AND opt8.ETC4 = 'ConsigneeAddress' AND opt8.ETC2 = CONCAT(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D) AND opt8.ETC7 = od.DOCUMENT_YN
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL opt9 ON opt9.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND opt9.GROUP_CODE = 'GOODS_SELECTION' AND opt9.ETC1 = '3Y' AND opt9.ETC4 = 'ConsigneeTel' AND opt9.ETC7 = od.DOCUMENT_YN
AND opt9.ETC2 = dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1)
AND opt9.ETC2 = od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
WHERE od.BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP' AND od.CD_TYPE = 'Y'
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat}) AND ${srchDateGbn} <= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND od.BOUND = 'AIR'
AND od.BOUND = 'SEA'
AND ${srchNoType} LIKE CONCAT(#{srchNo},'%')
AND ${srchNoType} IN (#{item})
AND ${srchNoType} = #{srchNo}
AND ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS, '') IN('', 'ERROR') AND ISNULL(od.INSPECTION_YN, '') != 'Y' AND (
OR opt1.CODE IS NOT NULL OR opt2.CODE IS NOT NULL OR opt3.CODE IS NOT NULL OR opt4.CODE IS NOT NULL OR opt5.CODE IS NOT NULL OR opt6.CODE IS NOT NULL OR opt7.CODE IS NOT NULL OR opt8.CODE IS NOT NULL OR opt9.CODE IS NOT NULL OR od.PIECES > 1 OR od.ECM_TYPE = 'D'
) GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO

/* SelectMngMapper.selectSelfSelectionListExcelUploadChk : 통관목록 자체선별(기초) 엑셀업로드 체크 */ SELECT COL_TITLE ,COL_TYPE_VALUE FROM exps_master.dbo.TB_SMS_CODE_DEFINE_COLUMN WHERE CODE_DEFINE_ID = 'ECM-014' AND COL_TITLE IN('SEARCH_TYPE', 'OPERATOR' ,'CHECK_FIELD')

/* SelectMngMapper.selectSelectionMailList : 통관목록 자동선별 선별마감 후 이메일 전송 리스트 조회 */ SELECT MAX(MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,CUST_CODE_LV1 AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,CUST_CODE_LV2 AS CUST_CODE_LV2 ,CB_CODE AS CB_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus WHERE cus.CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CB_CODE) AS CB_NAME ,(SELECT EMAIL FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus WHERE cus.CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CB_CODE) AS CB_EMAIL ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(CD_TYPE,'') = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS CD_TYPE_N_CNT ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(CD_TYPE,'') = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS CD_TYPE_B_CNT ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(CD_TYPE,'') IN ('N', 'B') THEN 1 END) AS CD_TYPE_NB_CNT FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND ISNULL(CB_CODE, '') != '' GROUP BY CB_CODE, CUST_CODE_LV1, CUST_CODE_LV2

/* SelectMngMapper.selectGoodsSelectionMailList : 통관목록 자동선별 선별마감 후 이메일 전송 리스트 조회 */ SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT MAX(MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(CUST_CODE_LV2, '') != '' THEN CUST_CODE_LV2 ELSE CUST_CODE_LV1 END AS CUST_CODE ,CB_CODE AS CB_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus WHERE cus.CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CB_CODE) AS CB_NAME ,(SELECT EMAIL FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus WHERE cus.CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CB_CODE) AS CB_EMAIL ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(CD_TYPE,'') = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS CD_NTYPE_CNT ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(CD_TYPE,'') = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS CD_BTYPE_CNT ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(CD_TYPE,'') IN ('N','B') THEN 1 END) AS CD_NB_TYPE_CNT FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{srchMasterOdJobNo} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND ISNULL(CB_CODE, '') != '' GROUP BY CB_CODE, CUST_CODE_LV1, CUST_CODE_LV2 ) A WHERE ISNULL(CB_EMAIL, '') != ''
